card_filters_note: Who is considered and where activity is counted
delete_failed: Failed to delete the stat role
delete_message: Delete "{name}"? Members keep whatever they currently hold.
editor_subtitle: Pick what to measure, how members qualify, and what happens when they do
field_activity_hint: Leave empty to count time in any game
field_announce_hint: A message is posted here whenever the role is granted or removed
field_blacklist_hint: Members holding any of these are never considered
field_days_hint: How many days inside the window must meet it
field_group_hint: Stat roles sharing a group keep only the highest tier a member qualifies for
field_ignored_hint: The role is never granted to or removed from these members
field_interval_hint: At least 10. Default is every 3 hours.
field_message_hint: Placeholders: %user%, %role%, %action% (earned or lost), %value%, %stat%. Empty uses the default.
field_name_hint: Shown in lists; defaults to the role name
field_perday_hint: What a member must reach on a day for it to count
field_qualify_hint: Threshold, top rank, top percent or a daily streak
field_role_hint: Granted to members who qualify and removed from those who no longer do
field_whitelist_hint: Members need at least one of these
field_window_hint: How far back to measure, 1 to 90. 0 means all time (not available for streaks).
list_empty: No stat roles yet. Create one to reward active members automatically.
list_subtitle: Each role is re-evaluated on its own schedule
preview_failed: Failed to preview the stat role
run_failed: Failed to run the stat role
run_message: Evaluate "{name}" and apply role changes right now?
save_failed: Failed to save the stat role
toggle_dm_hint: Send the same message directly to the member
toggle_invert_hint: Members who do NOT qualify get it (inactivity roles)
update_failed: Failed to update the stat role
